title: Our History
subtitle: Forged in Grand Cayman · The Story of Cayman Super Kings
history:
The story of Cayman Super Kings began with a vision shared by a few passionate individuals who believed that cricket could bring together a unique community on the Cayman Islands. Before COVID-19 changed the world, Gopal, Majin Paul, Christopher Balraj and Kiruba had already envisioned building a team made up of individuals who had moved to the Cayman Islands to pursue careers, build new lives, and grow professionally—but who also shared a deep love for cricket. Many of these players never imagined, before arriving on the Island, that they would have the opportunity to play competitive leather-ball cricket. They soon discovered that there was a growing cricket community in Cayman, with people actively looking for players who shared the same passion for the game. The plan was ambitious. Then COVID-19 brought everything to a standstill. The original plans were put on hold, but the vision never disappeared.

When life gradually returned to normal, the founders picked up where they had left off. In 2022, Cayman Super Kings was officially founded, bringing together players from different cricketing backgrounds and walks of life. Some members had previous experience playing professional cricket, while many others had primarily played tennis-ball cricket. Their passion for the game, however, pushed them to take the next step and embrace leather-ball cricket. CSK played its first tournament in early 2023 and has continued competing ever since. From the beginning, the team was built around more than just cricket. It was about creating a community—bringing people together, developing players, creating friendships, and giving talented individuals an opportunity to compete and improve.

The original founders played a fundamental role in bringing the vision to life. Gopal eventually left the Island, but Majin Paul and Christopher Balraj remained committed to the project and continued pushing the team forward. Rahul Garg joined towards the end of 2022 and became an important part of the team’s journey. Christopher Balraj led CSK from the front during its early years, providing the leadership and direction needed as the team established itself. After two years at the helm, he passed the captaincy to Rahul Garg, who took on the responsibility of leading the team into its next chapter. Behind the scenes, Majin Paul has remained one of the team’s biggest pillars. Often described as the backbone of CSK, he has played a major role in keeping the players together, maintaining team spirit, and ensuring that the bond between teammates extends well beyond the cricket field.

CSK was built as a developing team. Many of its players were still learning and adapting to competitive leather-ball cricket, and as a result, the team was often viewed as an underdog. But being the underdog became part of the CSK identity. Year after year, the team continued to develop its skills, compete against established sides, and fight hard regardless of the opposition. The team’s progress eventually produced one of its biggest moments in 2025, when CSK qualified for the knockout stages of the T10 tournament under the captaincy of Rahul Garg. For a team that had been built largely through development, determination, and a shared love for cricket, reaching the knockouts was an important milestone—and a sign of how far the club had come.

The growth of CSK has also been reflected in the individual journeys of its players. Christopher Balraj reached another major milestone when he was selected to represent the Cayman Islands national team and travelled to Bermuda for the Sub-Regional World Cup Qualifiers. It was a proud moment not only for Chris, but also for everyone associated with CSK. Rahul Garg also took the next step in his cricketing journey when he played in an international T10 league in 2024. He had the opportunity to share the field and dressing room with some of the biggest names in world cricket, including David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, Alex Hales, Thisara Perera, Beau Webster, Shakib Al Hasan and many other international stars. In 2025, Christopher Balraj was also selected to play in the international T10 league alongside Rahul, giving both CSK players the opportunity to compete alongside some of the world’s most experienced cricketers. Chris played under the captaincy of Shabaz Nadeem, while Rahul played under David Warner. The club’s connection with Cayman cricket continued to grow, with Rahul Garg and Gokul Krishnan both becoming part of the Cayman Islands national team training squad and continuing to work towards earning their opportunity to represent Cayman at the international level.

What makes Cayman Super Kings special is not simply the cricket. It is the journey. A group of individuals from different backgrounds came together on a small island, united by a common passion. Some arrived with professional cricket experience, while others started with tennis-ball cricket. Some had never imagined they would play competitive cricket after moving to Cayman. Together, they built something. CSK has grown from an idea that existed before COVID, to a competitive cricket club that continues to develop players, create opportunities, and compete at a higher level every year. The journey is still being written. With every season, new players join, existing players develop, new milestones are achieved, and the ambitions of the club continue to grow. The graph is only going up. And this is just the beginning of the Cayman Super Kings story.

timeline.title: A Vision Conceived
timeline.description: Gopal, Majin Paul, Christopher Balraj, and Kiruba envision building a team of professionals in Cayman who share a deep love for cricket.

timeline.title: The Birth of CSK
timeline.description: Cayman Super Kings is officially founded under the leadership of Christopher Balraj; Rahul Garg joins towards the end of 2022.

timeline.title: Tournament Debut & World Cup Qualifier
timeline.description: CSK plays its first competitive tournament. Christopher Balraj represents the Cayman Islands national team in Bermuda for the World Cup Qualifiers.

timeline.title: Captaincy Handover & International T10
timeline.description: Rahul Garg takes over captaincy; Rahul represents CSK in the international T10 league playing alongside David Warner, Carlos Brathwaite, and Alex Hales.

timeline.title: T10 Knockouts & Dual International T10
timeline.description: CSK qualifies for T10 knockouts under Rahul Garg. Chris Balraj joins international T10 under Shabaz Nadeem; Rahul & Gokul join National Training Squad.

timeline.title: Developing the Next Generation
timeline.description: Local school talent pathway, training alongside senior players, and continuing the upward journey of Cayman Super Kings.

leadership.name: Rahul Garg
leadership.bio: Opening batsman and medium-pace all-rounder. Led CSK into the 2025 T10 knockouts and played in international T10 under David Warner. Cayman National Training Squad member.

leadership.name: Majin Paul
leadership.bio: Co-founder and manager described as the backbone of CSK, keeping the players united and maintaining team spirit on and off the field since before COVID.

leadership.name: Christopher Balraj
leadership.bio: Led CSK from the front during its first two formative years. Represented Cayman Islands in the 2023 Bermuda World Cup Qualifiers and selected for international T10 under Shabaz Nadeem.

leadership.name: Gokul Krishnan
leadership.bio: Left-handed top-order batsman and wicketkeeper. Member of the Cayman Islands national team training squad working towards international representation.

ground.name: Jimmy Powell Oval
ground.location: West Bay Road / George Town, Grand Cayman
ground.facilities: Two-bay net practice enclosures, pavilion & clubhouse, spectator seating, floodlight training bays.
